faqs.question: What is IT asset management?
faqs.answer: IT asset management is the process of tracking and managing the hardware, software and licenses a business owns, including their location, condition and lifecycle status.

faqs.question: What causes data loss?
faqs.answer: Common causes include hardware failure, accidental deletion, corrupted files, software issues, virus/malware damage and physical damage to storage devices.

faqs.question: Can CODE3 recover data from a failed hard drive?
faqs.answer: In many cases, yes. Recoverability depends on the extent and type of failure — we assess this before starting.

faqs.question: Is data recovery always successful?
faqs.answer: No recovery service can guarantee 100% success in every case. We assess each situation and give you an honest picture of what's likely recoverable.

faqs.question: How long does data recovery take?
faqs.answer: This depends on the complexity of the case. Straightforward recoveries can be quick; more complex hardware failures take longer.

faqs.question: Can you recover data from a server or RAID array?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have experience recovering data from servers, RAID configurations and virtual environments, in addition to individual drives.

faqs.question: What should I do immediately after losing data?
faqs.answer: Stop using the affected device and avoid writing new data to it, as this can overwrite recoverable files. Contact us as soon as possible.

faqs.question: Can CODE3 help prevent future data loss?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can advise on backup strategies and, if useful, connect you with our backup and business continuity services.
